column1: # App set for the Guin (Retailers) site. Mirrors Frappe Cloud:
#   Vidira - Application / Retailers / guinerp.m.frappe.cloud  -> Apps tab
# Columns (TAB separated): order, app_name (python module / install-app name), repo_url, branch, access
# `frappe` comes with the bench; `erpnext` is installed by `bench new-site --install-app erpnext`.
# Branches and commits are taken from the Cloud site page (frappe/erpnext/india_compliance/payments: version-16,
# taraknath: develop @ 47a389d, POSNext: BT @ f7b3274). Change a branch here if the Cloud site moves.
# Install order = dependency order (india_compliance, taraknath and pos_next all need erpnext).
# Apps already cloned in ~/frappe/bt/apps (shared with other sites) are reused, not re-cloned.
